name: ch10_fig25_sbml_roundtrip_checks
prompt: Title (top): "SBML 왕복 검증" + smaller warm-grey "SBML Round-Trip Validation". Circular three-stage flow. Stage A marker "A" title "메모리 모델" with tags "반응", "대사물", "목적함수". Stage B marker "B" title "SBML 저장" with file icon "textbook_snapshot.xml" and checksum tag "SHA-256". Stage C marker "C" title "다시 읽은 모델" with solver tag "optimize()". From C lead to a five-row checklist with exact labels "status", "반응 수", "대사물 수", "목적함수", "최적값" and green checkboxes. Add a return arrow from C to A labeled "의미 비교". Use one red caution tag beside the file icon "저장만으로 완료 아님". Exact labels only, no full sentences, caption, logo, watermark, real hash, or stray text.
